historical_references.reference: Blight, a name given to the English monk who was the abbot of the monastery at Iona from 515 to 516.
historical_references.context: Blight was the abbot of Iona Monastery during a time of great turmoil and change in Scotland. He was a pious and learned man who helped to stabilize the monastic community during this period.
